introHtml: Full color decoration on mobile devices like power banks and phone stands lets you reproduce logos, photos, or intricate designs with photographic quality. This option is ideal for marketing directors who want to showcase detailed branding on giveaways that attendees will actually use. Unlike single-color imprints, full color allows for gradients and fine text, making your message stand out at events or in corporate gift packs.
